questions.answer: Off campus

questions.answer: It was not easy and also expensive. I booked through CheckMyGuest

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: I lived in Paris, and I had about an hour from door to door to get to the university

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: The registration process was not easy. I did not receive much guidance, and I had to be very proactive and follow up on my own. It was only about a week beforehand that I finally received clear information about what I needed to do.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: There was a person at the university that helped

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got about half of the classes I wanted

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don't stress about it, because everything just goes very slow at this university

questions.answer: BA
